description: The bar chart illustrates the average probing accuracy of different MLP variations in multilingual BERT models, with the size of the hidden layer(s) indicated in square brackets. The vertical axis represents the percentage point difference, ranging from -0.2 to 0.2, while the horizontal axis lists four different configurations of hidden layers and activation functions: hidden:[50], linear; hidden:[], linear; hidden:[100], ReLU; and hidden:[50, 50], ReLU. The chart compares two models, mBERT and XLM-R, using grouped bars for each configuration. The mBERT model is represented by a lighter shade, while the XLM-R model is represented by a darker shade. The bars show the percentage point difference in probing accuracy for each model configuration, with the mBERT model generally showing higher accuracy than the XLM-R model in the hidden:[50], linear configuration, and lower accuracy in the hidden:[100], ReLU configuration. The chart does not provide any additional annotations or emphasis on specific bars.
